_note: Pattern of a BROKEN packet — fields that cause known failures downstream.
_symptoms: customerPrice is null → store shows no price
productGraphicUrl is null → card shows broken image
channelId is null → instance not visible in channel store

_diagnosis.pricing_null: Packet was created before pricing was wired into the commit body (fixed April 21 2026). Rebuild and re-save to populate.
_diagnosis.channelId_null: Session was created without a channel selected. Instance query uses channelId == storeName, so it won't appear in the channel store.
_diagnosis.effectiveTitle_null: masterTitle and productName were both null at packet creation time — likely a session restore bug.
_diagnosis.productGraphicUrl_null: Canvas render failed silently (e.g. CORS on background image). Packet was still saved. Image shows broken.
